# Prefer fixing guff over growing this list. Entries here are accepted
# mismatches (message phrasing, enable-set gaps, known DEFERRED).

# WARNING: `--update-allowlist` rewrites this file from the current diff and
# drops the comments below. The rationale for every entry is kept in
# docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §4 (2026-08-13), which is the copy to read.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Why this file exists at all (2026-08-13)
#
# Every entry here appeared on the day controller-runtime's ill-typed package
# count went 16 -> 0. None of them is new behaviour: an `ill_typed` package is
# skipped whole by every analyzer without `run_despite_errors`, so these
# findings were being computed and thrown away. Recall is 100% and was before —
# what moved is precision, from a denominator that grew by seventeen findings
# nobody could see.
#
# That is the ledger's whole point in miniature (docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §1):
# a gate that passes because it is not looking is worse than one that fails.
# These are recorded, with what is known about each, so the eighteenth fails.
#
# Keys are pinned to the controller-runtime ref in corpus/repos.json, so the
# line numbers are stable until that ref moves.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# nolintlint "unused" is never the bug — it is the *symptom*. golangci reports
# no staticcheck/unparam finding at these lines because its own finding was
# suppressed by the very directive guff calls unused; guff's staticcheck and
# unparam do not fire there at all. Fixing the linter below each directive
# removes the entry here as a side effect: three went that way when SA1019
# learned to read a deprecated struct *field*, and a fourth
# (pkg/webhook/server_test.go:215, `//nolint:unparam`) is waiting on the
# unparam gap recorded below.
controller-runtime guff-only pkg/cluster/cluster_test.go:168:nolintlint:directive `//nolint:staticcheck` is unused for linter "staticcheck"
controller-runtime guff-only pkg/manager/internal.go:264:nolintlint:directive `//nolint:staticcheck` is unused for linter "staticcheck"
controller-runtime guff-only pkg/manager/manager_test.go:1819:nolintlint:directive `//nolint:staticcheck` is unused for linter "staticcheck"
controller-runtime guff-only pkg/manager/manager_test.go:1994:nolintlint:directive `//nolint:staticcheck` is unused for linter "staticcheck"
controller-runtime guff-only pkg/webhook/server_test.go:215:nolintlint:directive `//nolint:unparam` is unused for linter "unparam"

# unparam: guff reports an unused parameter on a method that implements an
# interface. Upstream builds `typesImplementing` from every `ssa.MakeInterface`
# instruction — `addImplementing(findNamed(instr.X.Type()), iface)` — and then
# skips any method whose name is in that type's list (`check/check.go`, "skip -
# method required to implement an interface").
#
# Re-read 2026-08-14: it takes *two* SSA changes, not one. `MakeInterface` now
# carries the boxed value (that one is done, and it closed the SA4006 golden
# extra), but the conversion here happens at `WithValidator(&podValidator{})` —
# a call argument — and guff's `builder/call.rs` pushes arguments without
# converting them to the parameter type. go/ssa's `emitCallArgs` does
# `emitConv(fn, args[i], sig.Params().At(i).Type())`, so upstream has a
# `MakeInterface` here and guff has nothing. An SSA-driven `typesImplementing`
# was written and measured on 2026-08-14: the table comes out empty, so it was
# not landed. `emitCallArgs` first — docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §7.
controller-runtime guff-only examples/builtins/validatingwebhook.go:55:unparam:(*podValidator).ValidateUpdate - oldObj is unused
controller-runtime guff-only examples/tokenreview/tokenreview.go:32:unparam:(*authenticator).Handle - ctx is unused

# One each, still undiagnosed — nobody has read which upstream guard applies.
controller-runtime guff-only pkg/internal/controller/controller.go:395:nilerr:error is not nil (line 394) but it returns nil
controller-runtime guff-only pkg/manager/manager_test.go:1361:bodyclose:response body must be closed
